content: Shatan Dzǝbiya Yesu
Yesu piyari dǝl Urdǝnu nyinyau ǝnga Mambǝl Cicau, Kǝ Mambǝl Cici lǝbiya Yesu a gwar tagǝu, aga shatan a gwa dzǝbiya nyi.
Ayukuɗa Yesu hǝr zǝmǝtsini nǝ pida foɗǝ kumunyi vuˈyi ǝnga pǝci, kǝ wuɓǝ mbari nyi.
Kǝ Shatan na anǝ nyi, “Ma nagǝ ngǝ zǝr Hyal, ga nar nyi anǝ tsǝka kau, aga ja sha aga macikǝl.”
Kǝ Yesu shaɗǝwa, ji na, “Tsǝtsǝfǝ nga nyi wu ndǝr Hyal abǝr,

content.text: “ ‘Aˈyi ǝnga sǝr sǝm wacu ngǝ ndǝ

content: Kǝ Shatan hǝr nyi a dar vi kǝra dzǝgamǝ gagaɗau, ka canǝ nyi patǝkura tǝlkur nǝ duniya, ǝnga sǝra a gwa patǝ nǝ pǝci kushu.
Kǝ ji na anǝ nyi, “Yi wu nǝ ngǝ dǝnama tǝlkur ǝnga kadakadarkur sǝˈyar kǝ patǝu, arya anǝ ɗar nji, yu sǝni nǝ nyi anǝ kalar ndǝra yu yiwu tsu.
Ma gǝ nǝ ɗa dǝgalkur, sǝˈyar kǝ patǝ wu ɗa nǝngau.”
Yesu na anǝ nyi, “Tsǝtsǝfǝ nga nyi abǝr,

content.text: ba tsu naja zhizhi nyi wacu

content: Shatan ɓǝra hǝr nyi a vu Urshalima, ba ji hǝri nyi a dar kǝra ki Hyal a dar vira ndiya ǝnga dzǝgamǝu. Kǝ ji na anǝ nyi, “Ma nagǝ ngǝ zǝr Hyal, ga vǝl a gyiwu ˈyi sara ǝnggau,
arya tsǝtsǝfǝ nga nyi wu ndǝr Hyal, abǝr,

content.text: ara ga sara dǝgǝri hiya gǝ ar tsǝka.’ ”

content: Ama Yesu na nǝ nyi, “Tsǝtsǝfǝ nga nyi abǝr,
Ənggǝra Shatan kuɗǝna dzǝ nyi wu lagu pamǝpamǝ patǝu, ba ji piyari nyi nǝ pǝci kushu ju sǝkǝ vanyi pǝci ǝnga ja.
Nji Piyari Shishir Dza Yesu A Vu Nazǝratu
Yesu sha a vu Galili, ǝnga dǝnama nǝr Mambǝl nga ja, ndǝr ar kǝra ja a tǝtǝlnar kǝr a ndu mǝlmǝ pamǝpamǝ patǝu,
ja vǝr highiɓau wu umbwa daɓǝ dzǝ njir Yahudi, nji patǝ a vǝr fal nyi.
Ənggau, kǝ ji maˈyi a vu Nazǝratu, mǝlmǝ kǝra ji hau a gwa. Pǝcir Ɓǝlsar, ba ji maˈyi a gwu umbwa daɓǝ dzǝ njir Yahudi, ǝnggǝra ji tsǝliya. Ji hyaˈari aga jiga ndǝr Hyal.
Kǝ nji nǝ nyi lǝkakaɗǝ nǝ Hyal nǝ tsǝfǝ Nabi Əshaya. Kǝ ji pahǝna ba ji uya vi kǝra nji tsǝfǝya abǝr,

content.text: Ji sǝwa ɗa aga ya nar nyi
nji lǝfau nda sa lar sau,
Ji sǝwa ɗa aga ya nar nyi

content: Ayukuɗa ji jigana, ba ji pǝɗiya lǝkakaɗa nyi ba ji dzǝgwa nǝ nyi anǝ ndǝr mǝl thlǝr wu umbwa daɓǝ dzǝ njir Yahudi, ba ji nggya gya. Patǝkura njira a gwu umbwa daɓǝ dzǝ njir Yahudi kau, ba ndǝ pǝnggǝri nyi li.
Kǝ ji na anǝ nda, “Ndǝr Hyal kǝ tsǝtsǝfǝ kau, a nyabiyar dzǝ wu himiya hyi ǝshina.”
Patǝr njira ar vi ta nana ndǝr kǝra mǝnahǝu ar kǝra ja, ba ɓǝra ɗa sǝ dǝdǝgur anǝ nda ǝnga sǝra wu biya sara wu miya ja, ndǝ dzǝgwa yiwa, “Kar ndangǝ ya, aˈyi zǝr Yusufu ta ngǝ wa?”
Kǝ Yesu na, “Anǝ nda a sǝni yau, hyu yiwu hya nar ɗa karapǝ kau, abǝr ‘Ligǝta, mbǝɗana kǝrngau.’ Mǝliya sǝ kǝra ˈyi nggari gǝ mǝliya wu Kafarnahumu, ǝnggau, wu mǝlmǝ ngǝ kǝ ɗǝm.”
Ji ɓǝra na anǝ nda, “Jirkura nyi, ca ngǝ nabi naja aˈyi ndǝra nji dlǝwuri wu mǝlmǝ nyi mai.”
“Ya nar hyi jiri, wu pǝcir nabi Iliya mathlǝkǝˈyi tǝsal aˈyi gangǝu wu ˈyiˈyir Izirayila, ǝnggǝra Hyal haɗiya mǝlmau, par aˈyi mai nǝ fa makǝru ǝnga hya kwa, wuɓau aˈyi wu ˈyiˈyi ta gagaɗau.
Ama Hyal aˈyi sǝwa Iliya a ndǝra zǝma nda mai, ama a ndu mǝlmǝ Zarafatu wu ˈyiˈyir Sidonu, a ndǝra mala tǝsal kǝra wu mǝlmǝ ta.
Wu pǝcir nabi Elisha tsu, njir pibi aˈyi gangǝu wu ˈyiˈyir Izirayila, Zǝma nda aˈyi uya cicikur mai kǝl Naˈamanu ndǝr Suriya wacu.”
Ta njira wu umbwa daɓǝ dzǝ njir Yahudi kǝ nggari ndǝr kau, ba ndzana huɗa nda gagaɗau.
Ndǝ hyaˈari ndǝ tǝɗǝbiya nyi a biyar ya mǝlmau, ndǝ maˈyi ǝnga ja a dar kǝra mau kǝra ndǝ hǝriya mǝlmǝr nda a dari, aga nda vakana nyi a gyiwu ˈyi.
Kǝ Yesu biya wu pama nda, ba ji mbari lagu nyi ba ji mai sǝ nyi.
Yesu Kǝdlǝbiya Mambǝl Ɗǝmwaˈyu Sara Wu Dza Ndau
Abangǝ tsu, kǝ Yesu sha shili wu Kafarnahumu, mǝlmǝ kǝra wu ˈyiˈyir Galili, ar Pǝcir Ɓǝlsar, kǝ ji dumwa ǝnga highiɓau, anǝ nji.
Kǝ highiɓǝ kǝ ɗa sǝ dǝdǝgur anǝ nji patǝ ara ǝnggǝra ndǝr nyi wu biya ǝnga dǝnama.
Wu umbwa daɓǝ dzǝ njir Yahudi kau, vanyi ndǝ aˈyi ǝnga mambǝl ɗǝmwaˈyu, ba ji hyaˈana ɗahǝu ǝnga dǝnama ji na,
“Wa yau! Yesu ndǝr Nazǝratu, mi dzǝ ngǝ ǝnga ˈya? Kari gǝ shili aga ga sa kuɗǝna ˈya ya? A sǝni ngǝ yau, nagǝ ngǝ ndǝ cici nǝ Hyal!”
Əngwar Yesu anǝ nyi ǝnga dǝnama, “Haɗiya miya gau! Biya wu dza ja!” Kǝ mambǝl ɗǝmwaˈyi kǝ mbilna ndǝ kau, a gyiwu ˈyi wu dzǝri nda patǝu, kǝ ji biya sara wu dza ja gǝra ɓǝra uya nyi ǝnga shilǝgǝu.
Kǝ ɗa sǝ dǝdǝgur anǝ nji patǝu, ndǝ na wu pama nda, “Abari dur gǝ highiɓǝ ka? Ənga dǝgalkur, ǝnga dǝnama nga ja vǝr ndǝr anǝ mambǝl ɗǝmwaˈyiˈyar, ba nda biya!”
Ənggǝ ngǝ ndǝr ar kǝra Yesu tǝtǝlnakǝr a ndu mǝlmǝ patǝ wu ˈyiˈyi kau.
Yesu Dlǝwari Nji Gangǝu
Yesu biya sara wu umbwa daɓǝ dzǝ njir Yahudi, ji maˈyi a vu ki Simanu. Sǝlkuya Simanu aˈyi ngga mai, gyangǝ nga vǝr tǝ nyi dǝdǝgalǝu. Kǝ ndǝ yiwa Yesu aga ja dlǝwari nyi.
Yesu taˈyi ar kǝra ja, ji kughi anǝ gyangǝ kau, kǝ gyanga nyi biya ka piyari nyi. Fina dzǝ aˈyi mai kǝ ji hyaˈari ba ji mǝliya nda sǝr sǝm.
Ənggǝra pǝci wu gya tǝɗau, kalar ndǝ kǝra ndǝ gǝra ngga ara ja, ndǝ shili ǝni anǝ Yesu, ba ji fǝri nda tsi patǝu, ba ndǝ ɗa jamǝu.
Patǝr njira ǝnga mambǝl ɗǝmwaˈyi wu dza nda ndu biya ndu wau anǝ nyi, ndu na, “Na gǝ ngǝ zǝr Hyal!” Kǝ Yesu kughi anǝ nda, ji kari nda ara ndǝr, ara ndu sǝni naja ngǝ Kǝrsiti.
Yesu Tǝtǝlna NdǝshiguWu Umbwa Daɓǝ Dzau Nǝ Njir Yahudi
Əmudlǝkura nyi, kǝ Yesu hyaˈari ji maˈyi a biyar ya mǝlmau, a biyar vi kǝra nji aˈyi mai. Nji biya ga gal nyi ba ndǝ thlǝwa nyi, ndǝ ɗa aga nda kari nyi ara piyari mǝlmǝr nda.
Ama Yesu na anǝ nda, “A ɗar thlǝr ɗa ya maˈyi a ndu alenyi mǝlmǝ aga ya nda tǝtǝlna ndǝshigu mǝsahǝu nǝ tǝlkur Hyal anǝ alenyi nji tsu. Agabangau, nga nji sǝwa ɗa a shili wu duniya.”
Ənggau, Yesu ɓǝbiya ɓau wu patǝr ˈyiˈyir Yahudi, ja vǝr highiɓǝ wu umbwa daɓǝ dzǝˈyar, ja vǝr tǝtǝlna ndǝshigu ar kǝra tǝlkur Hyal. Ba ǝnga ja vǝr shilǝgǝbiya kalar shilǝgǝu ǝnga njira gǝra ngga.

footnotes.text: Sǝra ndzana ɗǝfuwa nda ca ngau ndǝ sǝnbiya abǝr Yesu aˈyi wu nda mǝl sǝ dǝdǝgur wu mǝlmǝr nda mai.
